solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Crows about National success

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the horse's name is written backwards

parts.note: Red Rum won the Grand National, Britain's famous steeplechase, three times in the 1970s

explanation.surface: Someone boasting about a win in a big national contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crows' looks like a verb (boasts) but is a plural noun. 'about' turns REDRUM round.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of crows is called a murder, the traditional collective noun for these birds.

clue.text: Accountant dressed with abandon to get biscuit

indicators.note: dressed with says the accountant is wrapped in the other piece

parts.note: to maroon someone is to abandon them, as on an island
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: An accountant dressing recklessly to get a biscuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with abandon' reads as recklessly but gives MAROON.
explanation.definitionFit: A macaroon is a sweet almond or coconut biscuit.

clue.text: Grinned with fear, adjusted rifle sight

indicators.note: adjusted says the letters are rearranged into a new setting

explanation.surface: A marksman grinning with fear while adjusting a gun sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A rangefinder measures distance to a target, and can be fitted as a sight on a gun.

clue.text: No problem when you turn around

indicators.note: around says the other piece goes outside this one
turn means the word is turned back to front

parts.note: ye is an old form of you
as can mean when, as in 'as he left'

explanation.surface: An easy-going reassurance when someone turns round.
explanation.walkthrough: The archaic 'you' is reversed by 'turn' and goes 'around' the word for when.
explanation.definitionFit: Something posing no problem is simple or effortless.

clue.text: Church leader tucked into mixture of Viagra and Ecstasy in his home

indicators.note: tucked into says one piece is placed inside the other
a mixture suggests the letters of the drug names are jumbled together

parts.note: E is the common slang abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, taken from Church

explanation.surface: A scandalous picture of a clergyman taking drugs at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixture of' rearranges VIAGRA plus E; 'tucked into' puts C inside to make VICARAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: The vicar is the church leader in the surface, and a vicarage is the house provided for a parish priest.

clue.text: I mostly leave meal when retired; it's an obsession

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the pieces are read backwards
mostly means all but the last letter

parts.note: an exit is a departure, leave
a feed is a meal

explanation.surface: Someone who mostly skips meals after retiring and becomes fixated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims EXIT to EXI; 'retired' turns EXIFEED back to DEEFIXE.
explanation.definitionFit: An idée fixe is a French term for a fixed idea that dominates the mind.

clue.text: Gala producers say "Pretty Please", regrettably not "Thank You" at first

indicators.note: regrettably suggests things going wrong, so the letters are jumbled
not says some letters are left out of the mix
at first picks the opening letters of two words

explanation.surface: Children asking politely at a gala but forgetting their thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gala' looks like a party, but is the apple variety. Take T and Y from PRETTY PLEASE and rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Gala is an apple variety, so the trees bearing that fruit are what produce it.

clue.text: Letters from a bygone age

parts.note: BC, before Christ, dates an age long past

explanation.surface: Correspondence surviving from ancient times.
explanation.definitionFit: The ABC is the alphabet, the full set of letters.

clue.text: Being north of city

parts.note: esse is Latin for to be, used in English for existence or being

explanation.surface: A life lived somewhere north of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'north of' puts N after ESSE in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Essen is an industrial city in the Ruhr, western Germany.

clue.text: Badger cull even Noah grants

indicators.note: culling the even letters leaves the first, third, fifth and so on of Noah grants

explanation.surface: Noah granting a badger cull, even.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Badger' looks like the animal, but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To badger someone is to pester them persistently, the phrasal verb sense.

clue.text: Pelican as tall as some game

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A comparison of a bird's height with some kind of game.
explanation.definitionFit: Canasta is a rummy-style card game played with two packs.

clue.text: What England does first time old muscles seize

parts.note: ex- as a prefix means former or old

indicators.note: the muscles seize, or grip, a letter, so it goes inside them

parts.note: pecs is short for pectorals, chest muscles

indicators.note: first picks the opening letter of time

explanation.surface: An ageing sportsman's muscles locking up on the first attempt.
explanation.walkthrough: Nelson's famous signal at Trafalgar was 'England expects that every man will do his duty'.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition alludes to Nelson's signal, so the verb completing 'England ...' is the one meaning anticipates or demands.

clue.text: Reduce speed of maritime connection

parts.note: to reef a sail is to reduce its area by rolling or folding part of it
a knot is a unit of speed at sea, one nautical mile per hour

explanation.surface: Slowing down a shipping link or ferry service.
explanation.definitionFit: A reef knot is the square knot sailors use to tie reef points, a nautical way of joining two ropes.

clue.text: Like Victoria's children to wave flag carried by Albert?

indicators.note: carried by says one piece is held inside another

parts.note: Prince Albert was Queen Victoria's husband, so he is 'her man'

indicators.note: to wave a flag is to shake it about, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Royal children asked to wave a flag that Prince Albert is holding.
explanation.walkthrough: Albert is Victoria's husband, so 'her man'; 'wave' scrambles the flag, which is 'carried by' him.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoria's offspring had a German father, Albert of Saxe-Coburg, so their parentage was partly from that nation.

clue.text: Target bearing in order to return to cradle of civilisation

indicators.note: to return says the whole is read backwards

parts.note: to target is to aim at

indicators.note: in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit
bearing, one's posture, is a pose

explanation.surface: Aiming for an orderly return to where civilisation began.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Target' is the verb, two words AIM AT; 'to return' reads the whole string AIMATOPOSEM backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient land between the Tigris and Euphrates saw the first cities and writing, so it is called the birthplace of civilisation.

clue.text: Diminutive independent politician holds an open house for pot plants

indicators.note: holds says one piece contains the other

parts.note: Indi is a short form of independent
MP is a Member of Parliament
taken as written

indicators.note: open means the inner letters are removed, leaving the outside of house

explanation.surface: A small independent MP hosting an open house with potted plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pot' looks like a flowerpot but is cannabis slang.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian hemp is cannabis, the plant from which the drug pot is made.

clue.text: Determine position of Asia

definitions.meaning: to work out where something lies, as with a map and compass
the East, the lands of Asia, in an old-fashioned name

explanation.surface: Fixing where Asia is on a map.
explanation.definitionFit: To find one's bearings is the verb sense; the Orient is the old name for the East.

clue.text: Certain to mean rapid discharge

definitions.meaning: definite or explicit, as in a clearly stated purpose
to put into words, convey a meaning
fast, as a train or delivery service
to squeeze or press out, as juice from fruit

explanation.surface: Something sure to cause a sudden outflow.
explanation.walkthrough: Four definitions in a row; the theme's Murder on the Orient Express pairs this with 16 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Each word is a separate sense: definite, to convey, fast, and to squeeze out.

clue.text: Turn in healthy and sound when brought on board

indicators.note: in says the turn goes inside the other piece

parts.note: hale means healthy
U is a U-turn
din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: Someone turning in, healthy and sound, after being taken on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A haul pulls in a net or catch, taking it aboard a boat.

clue.text: A cat called Blaze

indicators.note: called says the words are spoken out, signalling a soundalike

parts.note: an ounce is the snow leopard, a big cat

explanation.surface: A cat named Blaze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blaze' looks like a name but is the verb, as in blaze abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: To blaze news is to proclaim or spread it widely.

clue.text: Car holds the edge when backed by fleet manager

indicators.note: backed means turned back, so the whole is read in reverse
holds says one piece contains the other

parts.note: Lada is a Russian make of car
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: A car with good road grip, supported by the person running a fleet of vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: Lada is a Russian car make; 'backed' turns LARIMDA round, after 'holds' puts the edge inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An admiral commands a fleet of ships, so he is its senior manager.

clue.text: One cause of MD being fired may be used in part of 9 18 23 down, 27 1 across

definitions.text: One cause of MD being fired may be used in part of 9 18 23 down, 27 1 across

parts.words: One cause of MD being fired may be used in part of 9 18 23 down, 27 1 across
parts.note: The cross-references spell AGATHA CHRISTIE MURDER, in which such a thing is used

explanation.surface: A reason a doctor might be sacked, linked to the puzzle's theme entries.
explanation.walkthrough: The bloggers could not fully parse this. Running 9, 18, 23 down, 27 and 1 across together hides AGATHA CHRISTIE MURDER; W plus MD stands for a missile or bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Every murder mystery needs an instrument of killing, such as a gun that is fired.

clue.text: Chain with holes

definitions.meaning: a chain is a series of connected rings
a seaside golf course of eighteen holes

explanation.surface: A chain with holes in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Links are the rings of a chain, and a links is a seaside golf course.

clue.text: Company called City is producer of windy flats etc

parts.note: rang means telephoned, called
LA is Los Angeles
taken as written

explanation.surface: A business ringing a city about something producing breezy apartments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flats' are musical notes, and 'windy' points to a wind instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: The cor anglais is a woodwind instrument, so it produces notes, flats included, by blowing.

clue.text: Skier's turn in hospital

definitions.meaning: a turn made with skis kept parallel

explanation.surface: A skier's turn at being in hospital after a fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A christie is a parallel-ski swing, and The Christie is a well-known Manchester cancer centre.

clue.text: Oil drunk a lot

indicators.note: a lot is taken away, read as the letters B and L, short for lot, removed from the front

parts.note: blotto is slang for very drunk

explanation.surface: Someone who drank a great deal of oil.
explanation.walkthrough: BL is taken from BLOTTO, signalled by 'a lot'.
explanation.definitionFit: Otto, also attar, is a fragrant essential oil distilled from rose petals.

clue.text: See 12
Rough tarred surface ultimately gives better grip

indicators.note: rough suggests the letters are roughed up and rearranged
ultimately points to the final letter of surface

explanation.surface: A rough tarmac road surface providing better traction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rough' rearranges TARRED plus E, the last letter of surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To retread a worn tyre is to give it a new tread, restoring its traction.

clue.text: See 23 down
Relative once removed confused on nicknames

indicators.note: removed says the letters of once are taken out of the mixture
confused says the remaining letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, the letters taken away

explanation.surface: A distant cousin muddled about family pet names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'once removed' looks like genealogy but tells you to take ONCE out of ON plus NICKNAMES; 'confused' rearranges what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A kinsman is a male relative by blood.

clue.text: Dormant fish brought round by sonar

indicators.note: brought round means turned back to front

parts.note: eels are fish
a ping is the sound pulse a sonar sends out

explanation.surface: An inactive fish revived by a sonar signal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought round' looks like reviving the fish; it turns EELS back.
explanation.definitionFit: Something asleep is dormant, inactive for the time being.

clue.text: Could be faster to make fire from air

indicators.note: could be says these letters might be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: Something that might be faster at firing from aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: To strafe is to attack ground targets with machine-gun fire from low-flying planes.
